citations.claim: Initial total energy baseline before motion.
First violating step: total energy exceeds allowed bound with no controller work.
Speed grew from 60 to over 63 despite no energy input, showing spurious gain after arena bounce.

counterfactual.change: Changed only restitution e from 1 to 0; eliminates elastic bounce energy injection and no violation occurs.

explanation: Elastic bounce against arena boundary with e=1 at high speed injects energy: speed grows 60->63.7 and total energy grows ~194J with zero controller work. Likely boundary impulse plus positional correction / gravity integration in substeps adds net work instead of conserving/dissipating energy.
vision_note: The body drifts near the right edge in steps 8-10 and then abruptly appears near the bottom-center in step 11. This sudden large displacement looks like a high-speed rebound off the arena boundary.
